audience_resolver_publisher_token.description: Publisher JWT minted from the Audience Resolver dashboard, connecting this product to an AR account so content can be pushed to its calendars. Set via connect_audience_resolver, not directly.

content_enabled.description: Enable/disable the content pipeline for this product.

content_posting_frequency.description: When this product's connected X account posts autonomous trend tweets. Either the legacy string preset ('daily' | '3x_week' | 'weekly' | 'off', defaults to 3x_week = Mon/Wed/Fri) or the object {days: ['mon','wed','fri'], time: '09:00' (Africa/Lagos, 24h), posts_per_day: 1-5}.

content_target_markets.description: ISO-2 country codes this product's autonomous trend tweets should draw trends from (e.g. ['NG'] for a Nigeria-only product, ['NG','US'] to target more than one market). Empty/unset falls back to [default_country]. Without this, trend-driven tweets pull from a US-only trend pool regardless of the product's actual audience.

id.description: Lowercase product id (letters, digits, hyphen, underscore).

intent_creative_direction.description: Free-form style/voice guidance for generated content.

opportunity_rules.description: What counts as a worthwhile trend/opportunity for this product — used when picking seeds and expanding opportunities.

opportunity_system.description: System context for generation prompts: what this product is, in the product's own voice.

publish_destinations.description: Where generated content publishes to. Each entry is one of {type: 'webhook', webhook_url, webhook_secret?}, {type: 'x_post', twitter_account_id}, or {type: 'ar_calendar', audience_resolver_project_id, audience_resolver_calendar_id} (requires audience_resolver_publisher_token to be connected first).

seed_picker_rules.description: Guidance for the seed-selection step specifically.
